user_saw: No failure is reported; ChatGPT subscription model discovery sent OpenClaw's calendar version (or 99.0.0) as the Codex client_version, and the fix's own live run only shows the new version working.
summary: Makes ChatGPT subscription model discovery report the latest stable npm @openai/codex version (cached six hours, bundled 0.169.0 floor, one-second lookup timeout) instead of OpenClaw's calendar version.
reasoning: The removed code came from #201493 (779c260b2e8a), which deliberately replaced #201130's npm lookup with the OpenClaw calendar version; this fix reverses that design choice on the grounds that the version is from the 'wrong release stream', with no reported failure, error, or missing model. Since a calendar version like 2026.11.5 is above every Codex version gate and the PR shows no failing request on the old behavior, this is a policy change between two designs, not a defect fix.
